history.overview: The Barracks were built to house and train the Muramite Legion’s core infantry.

timeline.name: Barracks Foundation
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves laid the foundation stones for the barracks.

timeline.name: Training Pit Excavation
timeline.description: Training pits were carved for legionnaire drills.

timeline.name: Beast Pen Reinforcement
timeline.description: Beast pens were reinforced to contain Muramite war beasts.

timeline.name: Ascender Conditioning
timeline.description: Ascenders began training for vertical assaults.
